component.name: Optical Analyzer
component.summary: Analyze spectacle lens optics, thickness, weight, materials, and frame traces

description.p: Optical Analyzer is a desktop application for ophthalmic spectacle lens analysis, physical thickness and weight modeling, lens material recommendation, and front-view frame contour tracing.

ul.li: Dynamic Spectacle Magnification (DSM) plots for lateral chromatic aberration, binocular prismatic difference, and meridional magnification ellipses.
Conic sagitta thickness, 3D volume, and weight modeling across Bi-Aspheric, Aspheric, and Spherical designs with edging chamfer and eyewire bevel depth.
Multi-criteria lens material recommendations ranking 12 plastic and mineral glass materials by optical clarity, thickness, weight, cost, and regional availability.
Occlusion-aware frame photo tracing and standard OMA/VCA (.trc/.oma), JSON, and SVG frame contour support.

screenshot.caption: Optical Analyzer main window showing the live lens preview, optical summary, and thickness table

description.p: First stable 1.0 release with finalized Go library APIs, validated JSON configuration and trace formats, and unified CLI tools.
Initial Flatpak packaging for Optical Analyzer and its companion CLI tools.
